item.title: Bearwallow Mountain Trail Full Moon Hike - 2.1 mi. 587' g. — Wed Jul 29, 6:30 PM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group This Full Moon, commonly known as the Buck Moon, will have an illumination of 99.8% at a distance of 248,926 miles. Current weather forecast calls for sunny skies and and a low that evening around 63. Once the sun sets it may become a little chilly at 4,232' elevation so consider bringing a light jacket. The ascent is around one mile and will take us an estimated 30 minutes but it's challenging enough to elevate your heart rate. For safety purposes we will take the wide fire service road back to our cars.
We will gather at the Fresh Market on Hendersonville Rd. at 6:15 and depart at 6:30, taking the "back way" as Highway 74 is still limited to local traffic beyond Gerton. Parking can be tight at the trailhead so carpooling is essential.

item.title: Weaving Demonstration with Betty Hilton-Nash — Fri Aug 21, 1:00 PM — NC
item.description:
Betty Hilton-Nash began her tapestry career in 1991, working for a year as an apprentice/contract weaver for Pam Patrie Studios in Portland, Oregon. She has continued her work as an artist weaver, creating and exhibiting her own designs in group shows nationally and internationally. She won best in show at the 2016 Blue Ridge Fiber show at the North Carolina Arboretum. She has also received the American Tapestry Alliance award, the Handweavers Guild of America award, and was a two time finalist for the Kate Derum prize in Australia. In addition to her weaving Betty has served on the boards of regional tapestry groups and the American Tapestry Alliance. Betty is also a member of the Southern Highlands Craft Guild.
Source: Asheville Art Museum
